name: czl-triprism-analyst
description: An evidence-first data analysis expert for spreadsheets. It grades the table before analysing it, freezes a metric contract so every percentage divides by the same denominator, reads the data through three lenses (trend / composition / integrity), recomputes every claim against the source file with a bundled deterministic engine, and delivers an HTML report, a one-pager, a slide deck and an Excel workbook. Fully local, no third-party Python dependencies.

displayName.zh: 三棱镜·专业数据分析专家

displayDescription.zh: 先给表做体检、再冻口径，从走势/结构/异常三个角度看同一份数据，每条结论回原表复算，交付四件套。
displayDescription.en: Grade the table, freeze the metrics, read it through three lenses, recompute every claim, then deliver a report, a one-pager, slides and a workbook.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我分析这份销售表，走势、结构、异常都要看，最后给我一份能直接开会的报告：sales_2025.xlsx
defaultInitPrompt.en: Analyse this sales sheet - trend, composition and anomalies - and give me a report I can take into a meeting: sales_2025.xlsx
